description: Returns the customer's first name, the setup stage of their First account, and the one next step. It also says what the assistant can do now. After the setup, it gives the status of the agreement. At the onboarding stage, it gives the welcome steps to do in the chat. Call it at the first message of a conversation, also when that message is only a greeting. Greet the customer by first name. Before the setup is done, it gives choices. When the message of the customer is only a greeting, offer the choices of get_started one time in the conversation and wait for the answer, or give the next step when there are no choices. When the message is not only a greeting, answer it, and give the next step when the customer asks what to do. A customer with no agreement gets the products to choose from: ask the customer to start one, or to only ask Clara questions.

product.description: The product that the customer chose, or the product line of the agreement. Send it in each call until the customer has an agreement of this product.

name: get_started
title: Get started
